item.title: Backup Ran, Files Are Empty? The Humming Freezer
item.description: The script said it finished. The folder says 0 KB. A calm story about the green tick that lied, and what a backup you can actually trust feels like.

item.title: Client Owes Me Money: Give Up or Take It Further?
item.description: A client owes you money and you're torn between letting it go and pushing on. A skatepark bench, a phone and a calmer way to decide your next step.

item.title: Client Paid Late Again and Wants More Work? The Tile Wall
item.description: A message arrives: 'Can you start phase two?' Invoice one is still unpaid. A quiet story about holding a calm line, without begging.

item.title: Undercut on Handmade Prices? The Kiln Shop Car Park
item.description: Someone is selling a lookalike mug for half your price. Before you slash yours, a quiet story about knowing your real numbers first.

item.title: CSV Dates Day and Month Swapped? The Corridor Chairs
item.description: You sent the report, then a client asked why you billed a day they were closed. Day and month swapped after a CSV import. A calm story, and a way out.

item.title: Customer Saw Another's Data in Your API? Oat Milk Queue
item.description: A customer saw someone else's data through your API. How did you miss it? A calm story about the message, the fix and what changes after.

item.title: First Quote, No Idea What Markup to Add? The Shelf Bay
item.description: Your first quote, a customer waiting, and no idea what to add on materials. A short story about the pause, and how it can feel calmer.

item.title: Forgot an Appointment Again? ADHD and the Cycle Path
item.description: 10:07 on a cycle path, your phone lights up: the call started seven minutes ago. A story for ADHD brains who forgot an important appointment again.

item.title: Ghosted After the Final Interview? The Charity Shop Queue
item.description: Final interview done, then nothing for eleven days. A quiet story about waiting, checking your phone, and getting your head back when the silence drags on.

item.title: Interview Tomorrow, No Questions to Ask? The Risotto Pan
item.description: Interview tomorrow and your mind goes blank when you think of questions to ask them? A quiet story about the stirring pan, the empty note, and a calmer way.

item.title: Invoice 90 Days Overdue, Client Silent? The Cake Knife
item.description: Your invoice is 90 days overdue and the client has stopped answering. A quiet story about a birthday party, a buzzing phone and a calmer way to chase.

item.title: Junior Dev Built Our API, Safe to Launch? Cake Tasting
item.description: Your junior developer says the API is done and launch is Friday. You're holding a fork of lemon sponge and can't tell whether it's safe. A story about that gap.

item.title: JWT Tokens Never Expire? The Key Box Code
item.description: Standing in a holiday flat, one sentence about a key box code makes you remember: your API's JWT tokens never expire. Is that a problem? A calm story.

item.title: Mind Blank in an Interview? The Frozen Smile on Camera
item.description: Your mind went blank in the interview and you couldn't recall a single example of your work. A quiet story about what happens next, and a calmer way to prepare.

item.description: Saturday, a trampoline park bench, and a client CSV that pandas refuses to read again. A story about messy files and getting your weekend back.

item.title: Phone Numbers Messy in Your CSV? The Market Stall Texts
item.description: Phone numbers in six formats, names in three cases, and a Saturday reminder to send. A calm story about messy CSV contact lists and getting hours back.

item.title: Robocopy Backup Failed for Weeks? The Vineyard Terrace
item.description: Your robocopy backup script failed and nobody told you. A quiet story about finding out on a terrace, and what a calm backup routine feels like.

item.title: Sold Out by Noon at the Craft Fair? The Empty Crate
item.description: It's 12:10, your table is bare and people keep asking. A gentle story for makers who sold out at the craft fair and wish they'd brought more.

item.title: Applied to the Same Company Twice? The Pretzel Stand Call
item.description: The recruiter says she has two applications from you, three weeks apart. A small story about applying twice by accident and a calmer way to keep track.

item.title: Backup Overwrites Yesterday's Copy? The Hotel Lobby Wi-Fi
item.description: You asked for last Tuesday's file and found only today's copy. A quiet story about a backup script that overwrites itself, and what calm looks like instead.

item.title: Payment 'On the Way' for a Month? The Sewing Repair Shop
item.description: Your client said the payment is on the way. That was four weeks ago. A calm story about what to say next, and how to stop dreading it.

item.title: Client Says They'll Pay, Nothing Arrives? The Piano Tuner
item.description: The client swears the money is on its way. Day 38, nothing. A quiet story about the piano tuner, the unsent email, and chasing without begging.

item.title: CSV Import Failed: Encoding Error, Deadline in an Hour
item.description: The import says 'encoding error' and the sale goes live in an hour. A calm story about weird characters, a ticking clock, and what changes afterwards.

item.title: Excel Removed Leading Zeros From My CSV? The Courier Desk
item.description: Postcode 01067 became 1067 and the courier queue is behind you. A short story about leading zeros, CSV files and getting a calm Tuesday back.

item.title: Falling Behind in Your Freelance Business? The Puncture
item.description: Feel like you're falling behind in your freelance business and can't tell where to start? A story about a flat tyre, a long to-do list and one small relief.

item.title: Inherited an API, Is It Secure? The Fuse Box Viewing
item.description: The developer left, the API is yours, and nobody can say if it's secure. A quiet story about the doubt of inherited code, and how it eases.

item.title: Takings Don't Match Unsold Stock? The Church Hall Key
item.description: Four crates left, a cash box that feels light, and a caretaker jangling keys. A market-stall story about the end-of-day sums that never quite add up.

item.title: Mind Racing at Night? Can't Remember Tomorrow? The Fridge
item.description: 3:20 am, tomorrow's tasks looping in your head, scared you'll forget one. A short story about getting it out of your head and onto one calm page.

item.title: Pentest Found API Flaws? Embarrassed in the Rain Shelter
item.description: The pentest report lands while you stand in the rain at football training. Findings in your API, a hot face, and a calmer way to see the next review.

item.title: More Edits, Still No Final Payment? The Apple Orchard
item.description: Fourth round of edits, final balance still unpaid. A photographer at a pick-your-own orchard, and what calm looks like when every shoot has a status.

item.title: Rejection Emails Piling Up, Lost Track? The Photo Booth
item.description: Rejection emails keep arriving and you can't remember which jobs they were for. A quiet story from a station photo booth, and a calmer way to keep track.

item.title: Shop Asked for Wholesale Prices? The Hilltop Signal Bar
item.description: A shop wants wholesale prices for your handmade work and you can't tell if you'd earn anything. A quiet story about finding out before you reply.

item.title: Stock Doesn't Match Your Spreadsheet? Shutter at 9:50
item.description: The shelf says four, the sheet says eleven, and the doors open in ten minutes. A calm story for small shop owners whose stock count never matches.

item.title: Fuzzy Match Discount, Below Minimum Wage? Fabric Counter
item.description: The agency wants a discount for repetitions and fuzzy matches, and you wonder if you earn less than minimum wage per hour. A quiet story from a fabric counter.

item.title: Two Job Offers, Can't Compare Them? The Zebra Crossing
item.description: Two offers, one deadline, details scattered across emails and voicemails. A Thursday-morning story about comparing job offers with a calmer head.

item.title: Undercounted Billable Hours? The Tea Van Lay-By Doubt
item.description: You're about to send the invoice and the hours look too low. A quiet story about the doubt behind undercounted billable hours, and what calm looks like.

item.title: What to Post for Your Small Business? The Late Pupil
item.description: Staring at your phone, no idea what to post this week? A driving instructor's ten spare minutes, and what a calm content week can feel like.

item.title: Which File Is the Latest Version? The Projector Cable
item.description: report_final_v2_FINAL.docx, report_final_v2_FINAL_neu.docx... and a client waiting on the line. A story about files everywhere, and the calm after.

item.title: ADHD Brain Fog, Can't Plan Your Day? The Cold Kettle
item.description: It's 10:40, the kettle has gone cold twice and you can't pick a first task. A quiet story for freelancers with ADHD brain fog who feel overwhelmed.

item.title: Applied to 100 Jobs, No Reply? The Pub Quiz Tiebreaker
item.description: You've applied to around a hundred jobs and heard almost nothing. A pub quiz tiebreaker, a blank answer, and a calmer way to see where you actually stand.

item.title: Bombed an Interview, Can't Recall What You Said?
item.description: You walked out of the interview and the answers blurred. Here is a calm story about what to do with that sinking feeling, and how to prepare next time.

item.title: Boss Asked If Our API Is Secure? The Dishwasher Silence
item.description: Your boss asks if the API is secure while you stand by the dishwasher, and all you have is 'I think so.' A calm story about a better answer.

item.title: Bank Payments Won't Match Your Invoices? The Paint Mixer
item.description: Three deposits, three vague bank lines, and a paint mixer that takes twelve minutes. A story for freelancers who can't match payments to invoices.

item.title: Client Pays 45 Days Late Every Month? The Shoe Shop Queue
item.description: The money lands on day 45, every month. A freelancer, a card reader in a shoe-shop queue, and a calmer way to deal with a client who's always late.

item.title: Client Pays When Their Client Pays? The Egg Timer
item.description: "I'll pay you once my client pays me." A freelancer's quiet Monday with an egg timer, and a calmer way to answer without begging.

item.title: Client Wants 90 Day Payment Terms? The Bike Rack Call
item.description: The client says their standard is 90 days and you freeze at the bike rack. A calm story for freelancers who worry about long payment terms and chasing money.

item.title: Committed an API Key to GitHub? What Else Did I Miss?
item.description: You pushed an API key to GitHub and fixed it in minutes. The real question is what else you missed. A quiet story from under the salon foils.

item.title: Craft Fair Customer Said Prices Too High? The Oak Board
item.description: A customer sighs at your price tag at the craft fair. Are you underpricing handmade work, or is the number fine? A quiet story about knowing.

item.title: Final Bill Higher Than Your Quote? The Paint Tin Lid
item.description: The customer holds your invoice and says it's higher than the quote. A painter's quiet moment in a finished hallway, and a calmer way to price jobs.

item.title: Customer Wants Extra Work on Your Quote? The Ladder Pause
item.description: You're up the ladder and the customer adds one more job. A quiet story about saying yes to extra work and still getting paid for it, without losing them.
